mainEntity.name: Where do the books ship from?

acceptedAnswer.text: All orders ship from Vienna, Austria. Delivery takes 2–4 business days in Austria, 3–7 days across the EU, and 5–14 days internationally.
Austria €4.90; EU €7.90 (free over €60.00); worldwide destinations €14.90. All shipments are tracked.
Yes — EU consumers have a 14-day right of withdrawal. Books should be unused. Request a return from the orders page in your account.
Bilingual editions print the Persian original and the English translation on facing pages, with notes by the translator and the author.

mainEntity.name: How do I submit a manuscript?

acceptedAnswer.text: We currently work through direct author and rights-holder proposals only. For translation rights, write to us via the contact page.
International shipping covers most countries, but payment and customs limitations may apply. Please contact us before ordering.
